name: Israel, Gaza & region
value: Saudi–Houthi strikes; 11 killed in Taiz 27 Nov
summary: Houthi media say a Saudi strike killed 11 civilians in Taiz on 27 Nov; coalition says it downed a drone aimed at Riyadh
state: Houthi-affiliated media said Saudi air strikes killed 11 civilians in al-Turbah, Taiz governorate, on 27 Nov; Al Jazeera could not verify this, and the coalition later said it destroyed a Houthi drone aimed at the Riyadh region (Al Jazeera). The coalition said it struck 50 Houthi targets on 26 Nov after the Jazan refinery attack (Business Recorder). WHO counts about 13,343 killed or injured in Yemen since August. Cross-border strikes keep the Alert.
for_you: Travel across much of the region carries high risk; follow FCDO travel advice for Yemen, Saudi Arabia, Israel and Lebanon.
rubric_hit: Major cross-border strikes between Saudi-led coalition and Houthis, plus Gulf attacks = multi-front

why: Conflict involving Israel, Gaza, Lebanon, Syria and Yemen threatens civilians, shipping and wider escalation. Direct hostilities with Iran are tracked under Gulf / US–Iran war.

rubric.alert: Multi-front escalation, major cross-border strikes between Israel and its neighbours, or mass-casualty events.
rubric.watch: Ongoing hostilities on one front, or a ceasefire repeatedly violated.
rubric.normal: Ceasefires holding across fronts (Gaza, Lebanon, Syria, Yemen).
